name: Brunei-Muara
intro: Brunei’s capital district brings together Bandar Seri Begawan’s royal and religious landmarks, Kampong Ayer’s historic water village, museums, mangroves and accessible coastal and forest parks.

places.name: Omar Ali Saifuddien Mosque
places.why: A landmark royal mosque beside the historic centre, known for its golden dome and lagoon setting

places.name: Kampong Ayer
places.why: A historic settlement of stilt houses and linked villages along the Brunei River

places.name: Royal Regalia Museum
places.why: Museum displaying royal regalia, ceremonial objects and gifts associated with the Brunei monarchy

places.name: Jame' Asr Hassanil Bolkiah Mosque
places.why: Large contemporary mosque with multiple domes and minarets in the Kiarong area

places.name: Kampong Ayer Cultural and Tourism Gallery
places.why: Gallery introducing the history, architecture and daily life of Kampong Ayer

places.name: Brunei Arts and Handicraft Training Centre
places.why: Centre showcasing traditional Bruneian crafts including weaving, silverwork and brasswork

places.name: Tasek Lama Recreational Park
places.why: Urban forest park with shaded trails, streams and a waterfall close to the capital

places.name: Bukit Shahbandar Recreational Park
places.why: Hilly forest recreation area with a network of walking and jogging trails

places.name: Berakas Forest Recreation Park
places.why: Coastal forest recreation area with picnic facilities and trails

places.name: Jerudong Park
places.why: Amusement park and family entertainment complex in Jerudong

places.name: Muara Beach
places.why: Popular public beach on Brunei’s northern coast

places.name: Pulau Selirong Mangrove Forest
places.why: Mangrove island reserve in Brunei Bay; access is by boat and should be arranged with a local operator

places.name: Serasa Beach
places.why: Waterfront recreation area near the Serasa ferry terminal

places.name: Brunei Waterfront
places.why: Riverside promenade with views across the Brunei River and Kampong Ayer

places.name: Gadong Night Market
places.why: Evening food market with local dishes, snacks and fresh produce

places.name: Malay Technology Museum
places.why: Museum exploring traditional Malay technologies, including riverine and water-village life

places.name: Brunei Museum
places.why: National museum complex covering Brunei’s history, culture and natural history; check current opening status before visiting

places.name: Mausoleum of Sultan Bolkiah
places.why: Historic royal mausoleum associated with Sultan Bolkiah
